title: Despicable Me
description: English dubbing scenes from Despicable Me.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 太毛茸茸了！
quotes: I saw that with my own eyes!
Let me explain something to you. You see how it's not knocked over?
让我给你解释一下。看见了吗？它没有倒下。

scenes.title: 那地板呢？
quotes: Rule number one: you will not touch anything.
Yes, you may touch the floor.
Yes, you may touch the air.

scenes.title: 求求你啦
quotes: Will you read us a bedtime story?
你能给我们讲睡前故事吗？
The physical appearance of the please makes no difference. It is still no, so go to sleep.
求我的样子再好看也没有用。还是不行，睡觉去。
But we can't. We're all hyper. And without a bedtime story, we'll just keep getting up and bugging you.
我们睡不着，都太兴奋了。不讲故事，我们就会不停起床烦你。

scenes.title: 抱住你的腿啦
quotes: Hi, I'm Margo. This is Edith. That's Agnes.
你好，我叫玛戈。这是伊迪丝，那是艾格尼丝。
I got your leg! I got your leg!
Okay, that's enough, little girl. Let go of my leg. Come on, little girl. Just release your grip. Wow. How do you remove them? Is there a command? Some nonstick spray? Crowbar?
好了，小姑娘，够了。松开我的腿。松手吧。要怎么把她弄下来？有口令吗？防粘喷雾？撬棍？

scenes.title: 特工露西
quotes: Hi. Agent Lucy Wilde of the AVL. Oh, whoops. Sorry. You're gonna have to come with me.
你好，我是反恶人联盟的露西特工。哎呀，抱歉，你得跟我走一趟。
Oh, you know, you really should announce your weapons after you fire them, Mr. Gru. For example.
格鲁先生，你应该先发射武器，再报武器名字。比如这样。
Lipstick taser! Oh, it works so good.
